structural_change: KDIE5-TV 10-22: release-die kit of qkd_kvs_tiles_hroot_ff_k_hl_mu_ba_n32_pj.sv module qkd_kvs_grp (module text identical to the k1 kit's qkd_kvs_tiles_hroot_ff_k.sv). Structural changes vs k1 (no RTL change): (1) outline = the release frame 222.576 x 1187.976; (2) pins = the release frame faces / bit order / port centres at a 2-track pitch (io_tcl); (3) landing SRAM g_pc[q] level with i_pc<q> (k1 had the branch order inverted: g_pc[0] at the top while i_pc0 enters at the bottom); (4) per-bit hck domains of o_pc / o_ctl (9bfa7f470) + hclk boundary re-read after every io_ref switch; (5) spine ck,hck; (6) rst_n landed on ck in 2 stages (+2 reset release, startup only), hrst_n stays an hclk input (a one-clock flow landing would land it on ck).
